style: Original 3D black comedy, deadpan slapstick, vivid saturated colors, high contrast, original character design
subject: ONE old grey goose: big COBALT-BLUE vest, long RED scarf, round glasses, white eggshell cap on his head. Calm, serious.
second_characters: ONE mole clerk on the pit rim: brown fur, mustard-yellow tie, white sleeve guards.
props: Giant cracked egg stamped 65: goose's, on the pit floor. Envelope with one gold coin: mole's, then goose's. Shiny steel shovel: mole's. Chalk rectangle 66 with a red flag on the lawn: mole's. Giant egg stamped 66: mole's, on the floor of a second pit.
environment: Deep fresh pit of ORANGE-RED earth with roots, in an emerald-green lawn; behind it a white columned office, bright turquoise sky.
lighting: Midday sun pours into the pit; warm key on the goose's face, magenta rim left, lime rim right. Blue vest and red scarf vivid in every shot, close-ups too.

light_events.event: sun flares behind the flying goose

motion_rule: camera always moving in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves from frame one, each ending on the gag; goose fills half the frame, except the close-up beats

audio.delivery: Goose only, dry deadpan adult voice 0.6-6.7 s, beak free while speaking; no speech after 6.7 s
sfx: 8.1 LOUDEST shovel chop, earth collapse, then silence

timeline.a: From the first frame: on the pit floor the goose's head bursts out of the egg 65, shards fly at the lens; eggshell cap on his head.
timeline.c: shoots out of the egg, close-up

timeline.a: Goose shakes his whole body, cap stays on; tilts his head, looks up with one eye.
timeline.c: spins up into his beak, close-up

timeline.a: On the rim the mole taps the shovel on his paw; behind him the chalk 66 and red flag; goose below stretches his neck.
timeline.c: soars up the wall, shovel in foreground

timeline.a: Mole drops the envelope; goose catches it in both wings, tears it with his right wing: one gold coin rolls into a crack in the wall.
Goose throws himself at the wall, scrabbles with feet and wings, earth pours, he slides down on his back onto the shell; cap still on.
timeline.c: tumbles down the wall with him

timeline.a: Goose politely points his left wing at the shovel, beak calm; the mole strokes the shovel like a cat, hides it behind his back.
timeline.c: circles the rim, shovel in foreground

timeline.a: Goose crouches, beats his wings wide: earth explodes; he shoots up out of the pit, red scarf streaming.
timeline.c: rockets up on his back, barrel-rolls into the sky

timeline.a: Goose slams down onto the chalk 66, bounces, flaps the dirt off; behind him the mole swings the shovel up.
timeline.c: whips down with him into the turf, mole and shovel in frame

timeline.a: Mole chops the turf at the goose's feet with one blow: the chalk 66 lid caves in, the goose drops into a ready pit; his glasses fly up, the mole's paw catches them.
timeline.c: hurls itself at the blade, drops with turf

timeline.a: Second pit, deeper: under the goose's fallen eggshell cap, the giant egg 66, a crack runs across it. Last frame: the crack opens.
timeline.c: plunges down into the egg crack, close-up
